jobs.description: Job description: Emirates Cabin Crew are responsible for delivering the Fly Better onboard experience to passengers across our global network. As a member of our Cabin Crew team, you will be the onboard representative of our brand, delivering our signature award-winning service while maintaining world-class safety standards. In the role, you will ensure the safety and comfort of our passengers, manage onboard service and maintain cabin cleanliness throughout each flight. You will respond to passenger requests, working collaboratively with your fellow colleagues to ensure a smooth flight. You will also uphold the highest of service standards in line with the Emirates Fly Better promise. Candidate profile: To be considered for Emirates Cabin Crew, you’ll need to be: Fluent in written and spoken English (additional languages are an advantage) A natural team player with a personality that shines At least 160cm tall and able to reach 212cm high Able to meet the UAE’s employment visa requirements At least 21 years old And have: At least 1 year of hospitality or customer service experience A minimum of high school (Grade 12) education No visible tattoos while in Emirates Cabin Crew uniform Salary information: Your salary includes a fixed basic pay and variable flying pay, which is calculated using number of hours you fly during the month. Salaries are paid monthly. What the company offers: Emirates offers career progression opportunities as you grow in knowledge, skills and confidence. From providing the best customer experience in Economy Class to leading the whole team as purser, we always strive to provide our staff with development pathways that matches your personal and professional ambitions. All Emirates Cabin Crew enjoy a wealth of personal benefits. Furnished accommodation is provided free of charge, with utilities being paid for by the company. When you’re on duty, you’ll enjoy free company transport between your accommodation and the airport/training college,

Are you looking for a logistics position within an innovative high-tech environment? Do you enjoy working in a structured and modern workplace where logistics and technology come together? Then this opportunity as a High-Tech Logistics Operator could be the perfect fit for you. As part of an international organization, you will play an important role in ensuring that materials and products move efficiently throughout the production process. Your contribution helps keep operations running smoothly and supports the delivery of high-quality products worldwide. What’s your job about? As a High-Tech Logistics Operator, you are responsible for supporting the daily logistics activities within the organization. You ensure that materials are available when needed and that outgoing products are prepared and shipped correctly. Your responsibilities include: Packing and preparing products for shipment. Processing and preparing outgoing orders. Transporting materials and goods within the warehouse and production areas. Working with logistics systems such as SAP. Monitoring the flow of goods and reporting discrepancies. Supporting an efficient and error-free logistics process. Contributing to continuous improvements within logistics operations. This role goes beyond traditional warehouse work. You are an essential link between logistics and production, helping to ensure that materials are available at the right time and place. What skills do you have? A hands-on and proactive attitude. Accuracy and attention to detail. Motivation to learn and develop within a logistics environment. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Good communication skills in English. Previous logistics or warehouse experience is an advantage, but not required. Certificates such as EPT, forklift, or reach truck are considered a plus. What do you get in return? A gross salary of €19.17 per hour, including shift allowance. Travel allowance. A modern, clean, and high-tech working environment.Opportunities for personal development and career growth. A dynamic and motivated international team. Long-term career opportunities within a growing organization. Holiday allowance and vacation days in accordance with Dutch regulations. You will join an international high-tech organization specializing in the development and production of advanced technologies for industries such as industrial automation, energy, and healthcare. The company combines innovation with operational excellence and offers employees a modern working environment where collaboration, quality, and continuous improvement are key. Employees are encouraged to take initiative, develop their skills, and build a long-term career within a growing international organization.
